jobs.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we've consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.



We're passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game\-changing solutions for our clients, and we're always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.


**The Role**



The Global Senior Financial Analyst supports the monthly consolidation and close process while serving as a key financial planning and analysis partner to the business. Approximately 30% of the role is focused on consolidation and close activities, including reviewing regional submissions, validating intercompany activity, supporting consolidation entries, and ensuring accurate and timely monthly financial reporting. Approximately 70% of the role is focused on FP\&A, including budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, variance analysis, management reporting, and providing actionable insights to business leaders.

* Support the monthly consolidation and close process, including review of regional/entity submissions, consolidation entries, and completeness and accuracy of reported financial results
* Review and analyze intercompany balances and activity; partner with Accounting and regional finance teams to resolve discrepancies and support timely eliminations
* Perform close\-related financial reviews, including account and P\&L analytics, flux analysis, and validation of consolidated results prior to management reporting
* Partner with business leaders to develop the annual budget and prepare monthly forecasts, including revenue, operating expenses, headcount, and key business drivers
* Conduct complex financial analyses and build financial models to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and recommendations that inform business decisions
* Prepare monthly management reporting, including financial results, KPIs, budget\-to\-actual and forecast variance analysis, with clear explanations of key business drivers
* Support department and business leaders in managing P\&L performance through ongoing financial partnership, scenario analysis, and evaluation of strategic initiatives
* Analyze historical performance, operational drivers, and relevant industry trends to improve revenue and expense forecasting and support long\-range planning
* Prepare and present variance explanations and financial insights for monthly P\&L, Financial Review, and Budget meetings; update and publish supporting presentations
* Serve as a financial resource to business partners on budget, forecast, transactional, and ad hoc analytical questions, including evaluation of financial impacts and recommended actions

  

  

  

**Qualifications**
* BA/BS Degree (4\-year) Finance, Accounting, or relevant field of study
* 4\-6 years' experience in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, consolidation, and/or accounting
* Prior experience with planning and consolidation solutions, Oracle, Hubble, OneStream, or similar financial systems desired
* Advanced Excel, Modeling, and PowerPoint skills and ability to learn required business systems
* Working knowledge of budgeting, financial analysis, financial modeling, working knowledge of accounting principles
* Demonstrates experience with financial systems and ability to work with large amounts of data
* Excellent written and verbal communications skills
* Strong organizational, analytical, problem\-solving skills with great attention to details
* Able to work independently and complete duties and projects under minimal direct supervision
* Employee may be required to work seasonal overtime to support the business needs of the company

OverviewSmalls is a premium DTC cat food and cat lifestyle brand built on a single belief: the cats who matter most to their people deserve food that actually reflects that. We make fresh, human\-grade food for cats, and we've spent eight years building a brand that looks and feels as considered as the product inside the bag.


We're looking for a Financial Analyst to sit at the intersection of finance and operations, providing financial analysis, reporting, and business partnering across functions. You'll support and provide leverage to our Strategic Finance Manager, particularly on core recurring and strategic forecasting and planning work — turning business strategy into numbers leadership can trust.


This is an individual contributor role with a growth path to Senior Analyst, for someone who wants FP\&A to inform operational and strategic decisions at a time to actually effect change, not after the fact.


**What This Role Is**
---------------------


This is the person who takes ownership of the recurring FP\&A engine so our Strategic Finance Manager can spend more time on strategic work. You'll own components of the budgeting and in\-year re\-forecast cycle end to end — data gathering, financial modeling, and variance analysis — and support financial close by producing source materials and coordinating accurate, timely accruals with cross\-functional partners. You'll also build out the automated reporting and FP\&A processes that let a lean finance team punch above its weight, leveraging AI tools, FP\&A software, or both.


**What This Role Is Not**
-------------------------


**A generalist role** — this requires explicit finance and financial modeling experience, not broad operational exposure. That said, some appetite to flex beyond core FP\&A for ad\-hoc analysis is a plus — the line is finance grounding, not rigidity.


**An over\-indexed strategic seat** — the team already has strong strategic thinking; this role needs someone tactical and methodical who can own the mechanics of forecasting and reporting.


**Who You Are**
---------------


* You hold a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* You have 2–4 years of experience in financial analysis, FP\&A, accounting, or a related analytical role.
* Your Excel and financial modeling skills are advanced — you can build a forecast and variance analysis from scratch.
* You have a solid grasp of the three financial statements and the drivers behind them; you can connect operational KPIs to financial line items.
* You are a strong communicator who can explain a variance to non\-finance stakeholders and collaborate effectively with partners across a range of financial backgrounds — we're a lean team with no translation layer, so this matters especially in partnering closely with Operations.
* Nice to have:


	+ Familiarity with AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) and experience automating finance\-specific workflows or otherwise using AI to improve your output.
	+ BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) and/or a planning tool (Vena, Pigment, Data Rails, Cube).
	+ ERP exposure. (Netsuite) — if coming from the accounting side, auditing exposure is preferred over implementation exposure.)
	+ Consumer/CPG/DTC experience.

**What you’ll love about us:**
------------------------------


* **Mission\-Driven Company:** We love cats and we're here to make nine lives ten.
* **People\-Driven Company:** We treat our people like people; we're committed to Smalls, and we work hard but also respect everyone’s lives outside of work.
* **Data\-Driven Culture:** We love using data to guide decision\-making where appropriate, but we also know when to move quickly and go with our gut.
* **Competitive Salary:** Make some $$$.
* **Very Competitive Benefits:** Fully paid Health, Vision, and Dental insurance. 4\-day work week. Unlimited PTO.
* **Fully Remote Office \& Culture:** Our team is spread across the US day to day, but we travel for department \& company off\-sites and retreats.
* **Free Product:** Free cat food every month.

Compensation Range: $110K \- $130K

**Summary:**  

The Senior Finance Analyst, Program Finance owns the financial position of the Enterprise Laboratory Instrument Services (ELIS) program: the profit and loss, the budget cycle, the billing accuracy and the savings the program claims. The seat also owns the arithmetic behind any commercial claim the program makes.  

  

The role reports to the Director of Sourcing and Payments, leads the Finance Analysts, and partners with the Regional Directors of Operations on the regional profit and loss, the Program Analyst on operational analysis, and the Accounts Payable Coordinators on the spend position.  

  

**What you will do:**  

Program profit and loss:  

  

Own the program profit and loss, including labor, parts, travel, tooling and vendor pass\-through.  

  

Own the monthly close for the program, including accruals, prepayments and reconciliation to the general ledger.  

  

Analyze and explain margin performance by region, site and service line.  

  

Own the forecast and the re\-forecast and explain the variance rather than restating it.  

  

Flag margin erosion early, including where delivered scope has grown beyond the priced baseline.  

  

**Billing and revenue:**  

  

Own billing accuracy against the contractual pricing structure, including named headcount, rate lines and pass\-through mechanics.  

  

Confirm every billed line traces to a contractual basis before the invoice is issued.  

  

Own the billing calendar and the resolution of any client query on a billed amount.  

  

Own revenue recognition for the program in line with Renovo policy.  

  

Own the commercial mechanics agreed with the client, including invoicing frequency, payment terms and any float position.  

  

**Commercial case support:**  

  

Own the financial arithmetic behind change orders, material scope changes and pricing proposals.  

  

Build the cost basis for a new or expanded scope from actual loaded cost rather than an assumed rate.  

  

Own the savings baseline, so any saving claimed to the client traces to a prior contract price or prior labor cost.  

  

Model the financial effect of self\-perform and RenovoCare conversion, including the step cost of hiring whole heads against fractional demand.  

  

Provide the financial view in client business reviews and in internal commercial decisions.  

  

**Budget and planning:**  

  

Own the annual budget cycle for the program with the Regional Directors and the sites.  

  

Provide site\-level budget and spend data in a form site leadership can use rather than only report.  

  

Own the headcount cost model, including loaded cost, burden and rate build.  

  

Support workforce and capacity planning with the cost consequence of each option.  

  

**Leading the function and control:**  

  

Lead the Finance Analysts, including work allocation, development and performance management.  

  

Own financial controls for the program, including approval limits and segregation of duties.  

  

Support internal and client audits with traceable financial records.  

  

Maintain the documented method behind every reported financial measure so any figure can be reproduced.  

  

**Qualifications:**  

  

7\+ years of experience in financial analysis, management accounting, commercial finance or program finance.  

  

2\+ years of experience leading a finance team or function.  

  

Demonstrated ownership of a contract or program profit and loss, including monthly close.  

  

Demonstrated experience owning billing accuracy against a contractual pricing structure.  

  

Experience building the cost basis for a change order, pricing proposal or business case from actual loaded cost.  

  

Strong modelling capability, and the discipline to show the arithmetic chain rather than only the result.  

  

Experience with enterprise resource planning and reporting environment.  

  

Experience in a service, outsourcing or regulated technical service environment strongly preferred.  

  

**Education/Special Training:**  

  

Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics or business required. Professional accounting qualification preferred.  

  

Training in GxP, data integrity and client site safety provided or required.  

  

Financial system and CMMS training provided after hire.  

  

**Required Competencies:**  

  

Traceability \- every number can be reproduced and will not be published if it cannot.  

  

Commercial Judgment \- builds a case on actual cost rather than an assumed rate.  

  

Billing Rigor \- confirms the contractual basis before the invoice goes out.  

  

Early Warning \- flags margin erosion while it can still be acted on.  

  

People Leadership \- develops analysts and holds the standard on method.  

  

Practicality \- gives operations a number they can act on, not only a report.  

  

Communication \- explains a financial position to operations and an operational reality to finance leadership.  

  

Integrity \- can admit mistakes, is direct and truthful, and acts in the best interest of clients, employees and Renovo.  

  

**Success Measures:**  

  

Program profit and loss against plan  

  

Margin performance by region, site and service line  

  

Monthly close completed on schedule and reconciled

Flag margin erosion early, including where delivered scope has grown beyond the priced baseline.

**Commercial case support:**

Build the cost basis for a new or expanded scope from actual loaded cost rather than an assumed rate.  

  

Own the savings baseline, so any saving claimed to the client traces to a prior contract price or prior labor cost.

Provide the financial view in client business reviews and in internal commercial decisions.

Demonstrated ownership of a contract or program profit and loss, including monthly close.
